text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — MedBank sent a compliance packet. SOC2 + HIPAA questionnaire attached, asking for 7yr audit log retention and Private deployment. Sales link: https://sales.example.com/MB-questionnaire.pdf

Marco Rivera: Got it. Putting into intake. Sales flagged KMS + VPC + retention as gating items. Ticket created CS-2789.

Jordan Patel: Quick check — do they explicitly require on-prem or is Private (VPC) sufficient? Need to confirm before scoping. @Alice Chen can you ask sales to clarify?

Alice Chen: Confirmed via DM: preferred Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS, but will consider on-prem if we can't meet retention requirements. They're asking us for contract language now.

OpsBot: New ticket CS-2789 created and assigned to @Priya Nair. Priority: high.

Priya Nair: Initial triage notes: main asks = long-term log retention (7 years), KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 evidence (Type II requested in 6 months), and Private deployment docs. This will bump to product if we need platform-level features. Any immediate technical blockers?

Sarah Li: Security reviewing the PDF. Need clarification on: PHI data flows, list of log types (access, system, app, audit), if logs must be immutable, and whether archiving needs to be queryable. I can do a 48h turnaround for a first pass.

Jordan Patel: Storage-wise 7-year retention changes the lifecycle and archive plan. Options: cold object storage with retrieval SLA, or a write-once archive with hash chaining for immutability. Both need engineering and cost estimates. Rough estimate: if we build a first-cut retention/archival API + export/restore tooling, that's 4-6 sprints. If on-prem packaging required, add packaging/smoke-test effort.

Alice Chen: Sales wants a short "launch criteria" checklist to present to procurement/legal. I drafted a simple list — feel free to edit.

Priya Nair: Paste checklist below so Sales can share. Team — edit inline.

```
- Security review completed and sign-off obtained
- Questionnaire answered and evidence artifacts uploaded to shared folder
- KMS integration validated (customer-managed keys if required)
- Retention configuration and archive plan documented (7yr) with retrieval SLA
- Private/VPC deployment runbook and network diagram provided
- Data residency and export/import path documented
- Audit log immutability or tamper-evidence documented
- Pricing and support SLA agreed in contract addendum
- Migration/backfill plan for existing data if customer opts in
```

Jordan Patel: Add: documented deletion/erasure workflow and a validated restore test for archived logs.

Sarah Li: Add: list of required SOC2 controls and evidence mapping (e.g., syslog retention, access reviews, change control artifacts). If they insist on probative immutability, we'll need to discuss WORM or HSM-backed signatures.

Marco Rivera: Created backlog epic PROD-5699: medbank-compliance-long-term-logs. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PROD-5699. Assigning to product for scoping.

SupportBot: CS-2789 updated: customer contacted 2026-01-15, questionnaire uploaded.

Priya Nair: Next steps (owners):
- Jordan -> schedule scoping call with MedBank; collect PHI flow diagram and exact log list
- Sarah -> complete security review and mark any controls that require engineering changes
- Marco -> produce storage cost delta and propose archive options (S3 glacier-like vs cold replicas)
- Alice -> confirm commercial commitment and whether customer will sign for Private deployment

Priya Nair: We'll reconvene after the scoping call to finalize acceptance criteria. Tentative 1:1 scoping call Mon 11:00am PT. If this requires code changes, we'll raise engineering owners during the scoping meeting.

Sarah Li: Acknowledged. I'll aim to surface any hard blockers within 48 hours.

Priya Nair: Thanks — closing this thread until scoping call. :wave:
